name: 77581 · Pearland, TX
findings: ZIP 77581 (Pearland) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77581 (Pearland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77581 (Pearland) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
